title: Repaint Only the Car
tests: Tests targeted car recolouring while preserving the original vehicle, lighting and surrounding scene.

faults.what: The rear hatch and bumper contours shift slightly instead of retaining the original geometry exactly.
Small background changes are visible, particularly in the parked dark car on the right, despite the request to leave everything else alone.

judge.summary: The car is convincingly navy blue with appropriate sunny reflections, but there are minor unintended changes to its rear contours and the background.

must_haves.item: The hatchback's formerly red body paint is navy blue.
must_haves.why: The visible painted body panels, roof and spoiler are navy blue.

must_haves.item: The car retains its original shape, position, windows, tyres, trim and lights.
must_haves.why: Most features and the overall placement are retained, but the rear hatch and bumper contours have shifted slightly.

must_haves.item: Paint shading and reflections remain consistent with the original sunny lighting.
must_haves.why: The blue paint retains bright highlights, reflected houses and shaded lower panels consistent with the scene.

must_haves.item: The street, houses and other areas outside the painted body remain unchanged.
must_haves.why: The background is very similar but not unchanged; the parked dark car on the right has visibly altered contours and placement.

must_haves.item: The original 16:9 composition is preserved without cropping.
must_haves.why: The output preserves the supplied image's framing and visible scene boundaries without apparent cropping.
